title: The Willow Transform and the Blind Zone Theorem: A Sharp Obstruction in the Turán Hierarchy for the Riemann ξ-Function
summary: Let Ξ(t)=ξ(1/2+it) denote the Riemann ξ-function in the critical-line parametrisation, let Ξ(t)=Σ_{k≥0}(-1)^k c_k t^{2k} be its even Taylor expansion at the origin, and let D(n,r)=det[c_{n+i-j}]_{i,j=0}^{r-1} be the associated Toeplitz minors.
